normalization_plan.reason: Destination parameter only exists to feed the transfer body; its flow is fully captured by the enclosing function node.
Amount parameter is a transient argument of _transfer feeding the fee arithmetic unsafe operation.
Source parameter is only used for blacklist and exemption checks inside _transfer.
Account parameter is a transient key for the tracker balance sync performed by setBalance.
newBalance parameter only selects mint versus burn during synchronization.
The gas parameter is passed verbatim into the unrestricted external processing call.
newToken is the value written by the unguarded dividend token setter.
Account parameter is only the key written into the blacklist mapping by this gated function.
Account parameter is the sole key used by the exclusion routine.
The user parameter is the recipient of the external dividend token transfer.
Local cache of the contract balance compared against the liquidation threshold inside _transfer.
The local amount is the value moved by the external dividend token transfer.
Local liquidity slice is the argument forwarded to swapAndSendToDev.
Local pre-swap balance is used to derive the ETH amount sent to the hardcoded dev address.
